title: Wavelet traffic-mirroring upgrade controller with health-pulse gating for private control planes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated, auditable controller that orchestrates phased control-plane upgrades for private VPC deployments using a mirror-then-promote pattern. The controller (wavelet-controller) will use traffic mirroring to shadow a percentage of tenant control-plane API and control-plane operator traffic to a candidate version, run health pulse checks (synthetic and real), and then progressively promote traffic by automated slices when metric gates pass.

Why: Existing upgrade processes are manual and brittle for private control planes. We need a repeatable pattern that reduces blast radius for tenants, measures compatibility early, and provides automatic rollback on regressions. This ticket focuses on the controller logic, Terraform hooks for creating the mirror path, and the health pulse gate logic that ties into Console telemetry.

Scope: Implement controller core, terraform module callbacks (apply/plan hooks), traffic mirroring connector for VPC environments, health pulse definitions (synthetic probes + real traffic sampling), promotion policy engine (wavelet scheduling), observability dashboards and alerting, and automated rollback actions. The work excludes UI in Console (will add follow-up PM ticket for UX) and extensive legal/compliance signoff (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: Controller can create and teardown traffic mirror attachments for a tenant's private control plane via Terraform callbacks
Controller runs preflight compatibility checks (version contract matrix) against a test replica and reports pass/fail
Health pulse aggregator computes gating metrics (error budget burn, 95th latency, reconcile failures) and exposes gate result API
Automated promotion can increment tenant traffic in configurable wavelets (1%, 5%, 20%, 100%) based on gate results
Rollback path automatically demotes mirrored traffic and triggers an operator alert with root-cause hints
End-to-end integration test exists that simulates a failing kernel-level regression and verifies rollback within SLA
Terraform module changes include idempotent plan/apply hooks and documented example usage in private-deployments repo
implementation_steps: Design: finalize wavelet state machine and gate metric thresholds with SRE and Console team
Terraform: add mirror attachment resource and a provider hook to expose mirror endpoint to wavelet-controller
Controller: implement mirror orchestration, candidate version registry, and scheduled wavelet promotion logic
Health probes: implement synthetic request generator, reconcile-checker, and sampling pipeline for real traffic metrics
Observability: create per-tenant gate-dashboards and alert rules (pager, slack) in Console
Tests: unit tests for state-machine transitions, integration tests in staged VPC environment, and a chaos test to validate rollback
Docs & Runbook: publish upgrade runbook, failure playbook, and Terraform usage example
